meta_title: Oni Web Officer — Enterprise Software & Legacy Modernization
meta_description: Oni Web Officer: a software house building event-driven platforms, modernizing legacy systems, cutting cloud costs, and staff augmentation.
hero_description: Event-driven platforms, legacy modernization, and senior engineering capacity — without the overhead of a full in-house team.
services_section_subheading: Four service lines, one senior engineering team behind all of them.
services_enterprise_software_description: We design and build high-performance, scalable platforms. Specializing in Event-Driven Architecture and Domain-Driven Design (DDD), we create backends that handle massive transaction volumes without failure.
services_legacy_modernization_descriptio: We rescue businesses from technical debt. Our squads analyze outdated systems (Node.js, PHP, Legacy Monoliths), refactor critical paths, and migrate infrastructure to modern, performant standards.
services_cloud_devops_description: We manage your cloud so you can focus on business. From cutting operational costs to implementing automated CI/CD pipelines (Kubernetes/Helm), we ensure your infrastructure is secure and efficient.
services_staff_augmentation_description: Scale your tech team without the risk. We provide vetted developers managed by senior software architects. We don't just provide heads; we oversee code quality, testing culture, and delivery.
services_staff_augmentation_proof_point: We operate today as a delivery partner to IT-services primes, staffing and delivering work for their enterprise end clients — the same offshore delivery model available to you, direct.
